name: agent-board
description: Agent Board session plugin: the kill-guard, bash-mirror and artifact-register mods (in-process; their shell hooks of the same names stay registered and defer to a live mod), the plan-handoff-guard, sdd-call-guard, agent-name-guard and context-inject hooks, the agent-status mod (session state from events, read by the board), the team-band mod (who needs you, above the lead's prompt), the usage-gauges mod (plan limits, context and cost under the prompt), the tmux-orchestrator and handoff skills, and the effort-* agent types. Loaded per session with --plugin-dir; nothing is installed into ~/.claude.
